_note: SYNTHETIC. Every company, person, vendor and line of dialogue below is invented for this demonstration. The seller is a fictional revenue analytics vendor called Acre Analytics. Competitor names (PipeGrid, Forecastly, SignalStack) and the partner tool Ledgerly are fictional.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks for making time. What prompted you to take the call?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Our board wants a pipeline forecast we can stand behind. Right now my team spends every Monday rebuilding the forecast in spreadsheets.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How are you handling that today, tooling-wise?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We looked at PipeGrid last year but it never synced cleanly with our CRM.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What would need to be true to make a change this year?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Budget is already approved for a forecasting tool in Q3, so the money is there.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Who else is involved in the decision?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Our CRO signs off. Can you send over a proposal I can forward to her?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Absolutely, I will have it to you tomorrow.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: One more thing, does it support SSO? Security will ask.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What is going on with pipeline reporting today?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: It is fine. We have a BI analyst who handles it.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How long does the weekly pipeline report take?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: A couple of days, and the numbers never match what reps put in the CRM.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What would it be worth to fix that?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Look, the price on your website is more than we spend on our whole CRM.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Understood. Most teams compare it against analyst hours.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Maybe. We are not looking to buy anything before next year anyway.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Would a case study on payback help?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Sure, if you have one for a healthcare group.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Here is the forecast view, rolled up by manager.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: This is what we need. How does pricing work for 40 seats?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Per seat with volume tiers. I will send the breakdown.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We run commissions in Ledgerly. Does this talk to it?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Through the API, yes.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Good. I want our CFO, Dana, to see this next week. Can we set that up?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We are also talking to Forecastly, to be transparent.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Appreciate that. What would make the difference for you?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Whoever gets our reps to trust the numbers.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What is driving the timing on your side?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We are hiring twelve new reps this quarter and ramp takes forever.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How long is ramp today?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Six months before anyone hits quota.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: And budget for tooling?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Money is tight. We got cut 20 percent in January.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Would a smaller start help?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: A two-week trial with one team would make it easier to get approval.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: I am not the one who signs, though. That is our COO.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Ahead of the renewal, how is adoption going?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mixed. Since Priya left, nobody really owns the tool on our side.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Who took over her responsibilities?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nobody yet. Logins dropped a lot over the summer.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Finance asked me to get a quote from SignalStack before we renew.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Understood. What would help you make the case internally?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Something that shows what we actually got out of it this year, in dollars.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How was the quarter on your side?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Very good. The sales team uses it daily and the forecast landed within a few points.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Our account management group in Canada wants the same setup.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Great, I can scope that this week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We would also want the advanced reporting package if it includes custom dashboards.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And we are not interested in switching anything. PipeGrid keeps calling us and we ignore them.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What is the main issue you want to solve?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Our CRM data is a mess. Duplicates everywhere, half the contacts have no title.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Is that blocking reporting?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: It is blocking everything. Leadership does not trust any dashboard.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Who owns the CRM?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: IT, and they will want to know about data residency and SOC 2 before anything gets connected.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: If you can get through security, I think we would move before end of quarter.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Before the demo, you should know we are pretty far along with Forecastly.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Fair. What made you take this call?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Their CRM sync breaks every time we add a custom field in Salesforce.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: We sync custom fields in both directions.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: If that is true, send me the integration docs and I will have our admin test it.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Pricing would have to be close to theirs, though.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How did this year go?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good. We would like to add the collections team, about fifteen people.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Budget for next year is approved, so we can do the renewal and the add-on together.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you send the order form this week?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The only ask: an API so our data team can pull raw activity.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How are you forecasting today?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We are not, really. The VP calls each rep on Friday and writes numbers on a whiteboard.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What happens when the number is wrong?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We missed the last two quarters and nobody saw it coming.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Is there budget set aside for fixing it?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: I do not know yet, I would have to ask.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: I do not think we need software for this. We need reps to update the CRM.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That is fair. Would it help to see how other teams got reps updating it?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Maybe. Send something on that.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks for joining. How is the team finding it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Usage is low. Most reps went back to spreadsheets.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And with the budget freeze, every tool is getting reviewed.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What would make it a keeper?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If it fed our commission numbers automatically, people would log in.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What is prompting the search?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: A new CRO started last month and wants a forecasting process in place by next quarter.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: She used SignalStack at her last company and liked it.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What did she like about it?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: The rollup by region. We would need that, plus SSO.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Send me pricing and I will put it in front of her.
